title: Conservative+
description: Conservative+ is a vanilla-compatible modpack built around idea «improve the game without breaking its identity»
body:
**A refined Vanilla foundation, engineered for stability, visual integrity and creative freedom.**

> Conservative+ is more than just a modpack — it is a baseline. It is a carefully curated selection of optimisations and visual refinements designed to address the inconsistencies of modern Minecraft without compromising its essence. It stays «Conservative» by respecting the game's original logic while pushing its technical and aesthetic boundaries to the limit

## Visual Integrity


We don’t add new content — we enhance the existing content. Our goal is to make the world feel alive through small, deliberate details, like


- Dynamic variability: diverse textures for axolotls, unique models for potions, enchanted books and goat horns and a lot more...


- Refined UI: A clean, minimalist interface based on official leak design concepts)


- Atmospheric depth: improved particle effects, sounds and enhanced foliage that remains faithful to the original aesthetic.


CIT & Data Pack Ready: Built with maximum compatibility for custom items and textures.


## Engineered Performance:


Optimisation here is 'invisible magic'. You don’t need to be a developer to enjoy it, but you will certainly notice the difference. Only ~200 MB heavier than a pure optimization setup


## Build or Enjoy: Your Creative Right


Conservative+ is an Open Foundation. 


I believe in the creativity of the community. You have the right to:

- Modify it: add your favourite mods or change the shaders.

- Fork it: use it as a base for your own project.

- Redistribute it: share your version of the 'perfect vanilla'.


> Note for Fresh animation lovers: If you wish to use Fresh Animations, it is fully compatible. However, you must replace the internal 'Mobs' resource pack folders with FA compatible resurse packs.



## Technical recommendations


During installation via Prism Launcher or Modrinth, you will be prompted to select specific components:


C2ME: recommended only if you have a CPU with a high core count and a dedicated GPU.

3D Skin Layers: An optional aesthetic choice for those who want that extra bit of depth.


## Part of the Ecosystem

Although this pack is a standalone product, it is the recommended way to experience the Conservative+ Server. It ensures that what you see is exactly what was intended: a calm, non-toxic and visually consistent world.
